story.title: Our Heritage & Story
story.placeholderText: The story of Bengal handloom and Shyamasree Bostraloy.
story.heroTitle: The Story & Heritage of Shyamasree Bostraloy
story.heroSubtitle: Trusted destination for Bengal's traditional handloom weaving and contemporary boutique fashion in Paschim Medinipur.
story.historyText1: Located opposite Dingal Post Office at Dingal Hattala, West Midnapore, Shyamasree Bostraloy was founded by proprietor Abani Bar with a vision of personal care and dedication to textile quality.
story.historyText2: Our mission has always been to bring authentic Bengali handloom sarees, Kanjivaram, Katan silk, Baluchari, Dhakai Jamdani, and festive wear to local families at fair and transparent prices.
story.craftsmanshipDesc: Every thread and pattern embodies the dedication and artistic heritage of Bengal's master weavers and Midnapore textile artisans.
story.timelineStep1Desc: Carefully sourcing fine cotton, premium tussar, and pure mulberry silk yarns.
story.timelineStep2Desc: Skilled weavers bring traditional Bengal motifs to life on handlooms.
story.timelineStep3Desc: Checking fabric durability, colorfastness, and finish before store presentation.
story.timelineStep4Desc: Creating memorable experiences for weddings, Pujas, and family celebrations.
story.statYearsLabel: Serving the textile industry with honor
story.statProductsLabel: Curated sarees, suits, and handloom attire
story.philosophy1Desc: No inflated claims — only genuine fabrics and transparent business practices.
story.philosophy2Desc: Direct relationship with weaving hubs to ensure accessible pricing.
story.philosophy3Desc: Welcoming every guest at Dingal Hattala like family.
